plan.title: bug(check): Windows release Step 5 still exits 124 after #4591 cheapening

narratives.Overview:
v0.119.3 Step 5 ts:check-lane died at the 20-minute hang detector (exit 124) on HEAD 19521dc64. Named-cause cited the #4506 D7 negative fixture because a killed suite has no Tests N failed summary. Last-file ticks did not appear in the captured log. Recurrence of #4567/#4591; do not raise RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS.

PR 4745 ships diagnostics and ranked cheapening only. Dest ts:check-lane measured 25.52 min at 8 workers, still over 20 minutes. The 20-minute Step 5 close stays leftover on this issue (spawn-heavy one-worker tail: pack-smoke tsc, occupancy-stress children, ci_lifecycle_lane, leftover execPath boots).
narratives.AcceptanceCriteria:
- Leftover (not this PR): When Windows release Step 5 / ts:check-lane runs vitest --coverage at this lineage, the suite completes under 20 minutes (measured wall clock on this host).
- When the hang detector fires, named-cause for exit 124 names timeout/hang and the last completed test file when known, and does not cite the D7 negative fixture as the product fail.
- When the hang detector fires, last-file progress ticks appear in the same capture that records the 124.
- Rank remaining cost (CLI boots, occupancy filesystem, leftover git-worktree, new files since #4591) and cheapen via existing seams: spawn-heavy project, in-process routeAndDispatch, share-plus-reset. Occupancy stays per-it unless a reset is proven.
- Do not raise RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS.
narratives.Test:
- When named-cause is given a 124 with the D7 FAIL: fixture line and no Tests N failed summary, it names timeout/hang rather than the fixture.
- When the progress reporter completes files, last-file lines are written with writeFlushedLine.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: PR 4745 ships named-cause, last-file ticks, occupancy share-plus-reset, spawn-heavy partition, and evaluator-surface disclosure. Tracking #4744, not Closes. 20-minute wall is leftover on #4744.
